principle: A gift to turn to voluntarily; no guilt, compulsory schedules or hidden assistant permissions.

validation.automated: 23 regression cases: original templates, AI action scope, all-character coverage of 123 pages, final-page retrieval, quote/page verification, fingerprint invalidation, cancel/resume, hierarchical reduction with mocked AI, PDF order/rotation, filename collisions, header isolation, pixel edit boundaries, native diagram/slide bounds, active-design handoff.
browser: Imported a real 123-page PDF; asked about a unique fact on page 123; AI returned the correct 47-participant answer and exact source; source button opened page 123.
Imported an image-only PDF; OCR reproduced both synthetic English sentences; source remained unchanged until manual confirmation.
Analyzed a Vietnamese text fixture retaining negation and study limitations; generated editable report, flashcard questions, mindmap and 3-page PowerPoint. PowerPoint ZIP content checked.
Filled split-run DOCX placeholders including header and table cell; unchanged images/styles/relationships preserved. LibreOffice rendered output with table, picture, margins, header and footer.
Exported a genuine DOCX containing article text and a DOI bibliography. XML verified; LibreOffice opened and rendered output.
Created and downloaded a purpose-based Vietnamese email draft; no email sent.
Exported only PDF pages 122-123 to two JPEGs in ZIP; downloaded PNG after local object removal; checked PNG format and background pixel restoration.
Loaded browser model and executed subject selection; tested English grammar tutor with exact-original feedback; CV proposals required preview, applied and successfully undone.

Queried Crossref metadata for DOI 10.1177/1529100612453266. Evidence check declined an unsupported effectiveness claim from the available excerpt; accepted a claim explicitly stated in the abstract and inserted citation/bibliography.
limits: OCR and AI suggestions require review; tested scan is a clear synthetic fixture, not a quantified accuracy benchmark.
Hierarchical coverage and resume have deterministic mocked-AI tests; the 123-page ingestion and final-page question were tested in browser against the real AI service.
Question answering uses lexical retrieval and discloses searched coverage; it is not semantic search over every sentence.
Crossref search finds metadata candidates; relevance and support are separate. Positive support receives a second AI audit and exact quote/page validation. This is not proof of research quality.
Original DOCX layout is preserved through template replacement. Writing import/export preserves semantic text, lists and tables rather than arbitrary Word page layout or embedded images.
Object removal uses local neighboring colors for small objects on simple backgrounds, not generative reconstruction. Image workspace downscales to 1600px.
TTS and optional speech input depend on browser/device support; microphone capture was not enabled during QA.
Learning units are original starting frameworks with official resource links, not copied institutional courses or formal proficiency assessment.
Rust/native iOS remains a future direction. Public image-generation service remains unconfigured as previously discussed.
